# GramDL — Instagram Video & Reel Downloader
# https://gramdl.com
# llms.txt — guidance for AI agents and language models

## What is GramDL?
GramDL (https://gramdl.com) is a free, browser-based tool for downloading Instagram
videos, reels, photos, carousels, and stories without watermarks. No account or
registration required.

## Key Features
- Download Instagram Reels, Videos, Photos, Carousels, Stories
- Works on iPhone, Android, desktop (all browsers)
- No watermark, HD quality
- No registration required
- 100% free

## Tool Pages
- / — Main downloader (all content types)
- /instagram-reel-downloader — Reels
- /instagram-video-downloader — Videos
- /instagram-photo-downloader — Photos
- /instagram-carousel-downloader — Carousels (multi-image posts)
- /instagram-story-downloader — Stories

## How to Use
1. Copy an Instagram post/reel/video URL
2. Paste it into the input box at https://gramdl.com
3. Click Download
4. Save the file to your device
